finding: Gazebo-side IMU and NavSat output requires both the world-system plugins and IMU/NavSat sensor entities in the generated model.

model_requirement.reason: The default Otter model generation path leaves phaseASensors disabled and therefore emits no task_imu or task_gps sensor entities. World plugins alone cannot publish IMU or NavSat topics.

outstanding_task_3_check.reason: Docker daemon was unavailable during provenance reconciliation.
outstanding_task_3_check.required_action: Generate the model with phaseASensors enabled, validate SDF loading under pinned Harmonic 8.15.0, and confirm live IMU and NavSat topic publication during Task 3.

non_inference: The 8.14-versus-8.15 version difference cannot explain the observed absence of topics because the tested default model contains no sensor entities; nevertheless, pinned 8.15 verification remains mandatory.
